serialNotSupported: Web Serial API is not supported in this browser
usbNotSupported: WebUSB is not supported in this browser
name: Name
notLinkedToRunner: Not linked to any runner in this event
notMeasured: Not measured — re-read card to measure
searchRunnerPlaceholder: Search runner by name or card...
printerNotConnected: Connect a printer first to view its settings.
printerNotSupported: Printer configuration is not supported for this printer model.
printerStarTsp100Note: Star TSP100-family printer detected. Receipts are rendered as raster images (the TSP100 doesn't accept ESC/POS commands). No model-specific configuration is available — use the printer's hardware FEED + power-on for self-test.
modeVirtualComDescription: Vendor-specific class. No OS driver auto-binds. Recommended for kiosk laptops.
modePrinterClassDescription: Standard USB printer class. OS printer drivers attach and require Zadig (Windows) or a udev unbind rule (Linux) to free the device for WebUSB.
switchModeConfirmBody: This will change the printer's USB identity. After the flash command is sent you must power-cycle the printer for the change to take effect. The printer will then re-enumerate as a different USB device and you'll need to reconnect.
switchModeConfirmBodyBorrowed: This printer is borrowed equipment — remember to flip it back to {{mode}} mode before returning it.
flashSuccessBody: Now power-cycle the printer (turn off, wait two seconds, turn on). It will re-enumerate as a {{mode}} device. Reconnect from the printer button when it comes back.
powerCycleAcknowledge: I will power-cycle the printer now
memorySwitchesIdleNote: The current USB mode is read from the USB descriptor and is reliable; reading the full memory switch table is optional and may not be supported on every firmware.
memorySwitchesIdleNoteVirtualCom: The current USB mode is read from the USB descriptor and is reliable. Reading the full memory switch table over Virtual COM is known to be flaky on some Citizen firmwares (the printer often returns background status bytes instead of the documented response). For an authoritative dump, use the Print self-test button below — or temporarily flip back to Printer Class mode where reads are reliable.
memorySwitchesUnsupportedNote: This firmware doesn't appear to support the GS ( E read command in the current USB mode. Use the Print self-test button below for an authoritative settings dump.
printSelfTestDescription: Prints the printer's built-in test slip including current memory switch values.
printSelfTestDescriptionStar: Prints a small known raster pattern (one black bar) followed by a partial cut. Confirms the wire format and cut behavior.
printSelfTestNoteStar: For the printer's full hardware self-test, hold FEED while powering the printer on.
printSelfTestDisconnectNote: Note: the printer commonly disconnects from USB during the self-test print. If that happens, click Connect Printer in the header to reconnect once it has finished printing.
printChangeListNote: Power-cycle and re-enter Individual Setting Mode (cover open + FEED + power, two presses, close cover) to print the labelled Change List.
borrowedWarningBody: This printer was flashed from {{from}} to {{to}} on {{when}}. Restore it to {{from}} before returning it.
